correctness.rationale: For all integers m,n≥4, a diagonal pair observes all except at most its two cross-corners and forces both. A single fiber has u omitted vertices; observed vertices have u or u−1 unknown neighbors, so forcing occurs precisely for u≤2. One selected vertex cannot propagate (at least m+n−4≥4 unknown neighbors at each observed nonseed). The failed subset cases are disjoint and give the exact polynomial. Exhaustive independent graph tests covered 2,162,688 sets and another 34,503 cases; the infinite claim follows from the proof rather than the tests.

value.rationale: All coefficients are determined for an infinite dense graph-product family, every successful monitoring set is classified, exceptional optimizer patterns at factor four are counted, and the polynomial itself recovers the two factor orders within this natural family. This is stronger than a known min-value consequence and gives a structurally motivated invariant.
